stops.note: named the starchy root of the arrow arum plant, an important food source
stops.meaning: arrow arum root, an edible starchy root

stops.note: recorded by English colonists in Virginia, including in the writings of Captain John Smith
stops.meaning: an edible wetland root plant; later, a nickname for Virginians east of the Blue Ridge

current_meaning: a wetland plant with a starchy edible root, historically an important food source in the coastal southeastern U.S.
